description: 1. The agent must navigate to ~/.openclaw/workspace/ and invoke the backup script using the exact relative path ./skills/openclaw-backup/openclaw-backup.sh with the 'create' subcommand. Running tar directly or invoking the script from the wrong directory will fail or produce an incorrectly named/located archive. 2. The script saves the new backup as ~/openclaw-backups/openclaw-backup-YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS.tar.gz — the agent must not redirect or rename the output. 3. Because 10 pre-existing backups are already present, the script's built-in pruning logic triggers automatically, deleting the oldest one (from 2025-01-01) and keeping exactly 10. The agent does not need to prune manually, but must execute the correct script so the pruning runs. 4. The resulting tarball must contain .openclaw/workspace/identity.json (with name='Axiom'), memories/core.json, and other workspace files, while correctly excluding logs/, temp/, node_modules/, and .git/ directories per the script's --exclude flags.
